name: sqlselect_execute_query
description:
Runs a SQL SELECT over the configured data sources with DuckDB. Data sources are the named files configured in this tool's data_sources (CSV, Parquet or JSON in data.sqlselect.dir, default data/sqlselect), each loaded into a DuckDB table named after the source when the tool starts, with file and URL access then switched off; a source whose file is missing is listed but cannot be queried.
Returns {success, columns, rows, row_count, query, timestamp}: rows are objects keyed by column; on failure {success: false, error, timestamp}.
Inputs (* required): query* (must start with SELECT, so no WITH; one read-only statement; refused if it contains the word DROP, DELETE, UPDATE, INSERT, CREATE, ALTER or TRUNCATE (whole words only, so created_at is fine)), limit (1-10000; default 100; appended when the text has no LIMIT).
For the files in the DuckDB data folder use duckdb_query.
Example: {"query": "SELECT product_category, SUM(quantity) AS qty FROM orders GROUP BY product_category", "limit": 50}

sales.description: Sales data with customer and product details

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return

examples.query: SELECT product_category, SUM(quantity) AS qty FROM orders GROUP BY product_category

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Only SELECT queries allowed. Prevents DROP, DELETE, UPDATE, INSERT, CREATE, ALTER, TRUNCATE operations for safety.

input.query: SELECT product_id, SUM(amount) as total_sales FROM sales GROUP BY product_id ORDER BY total_sales DESC
SELECT c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_name
